page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance belonging to the ecs.sn2 family. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores, supported by 64.0 GB of RAM, which provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and it features a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks show a contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression ranking in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core performance is average, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU scores all placing in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks also demonstrate average performance.

This instance is appropriate for general-purpose workloads that can leverage multi-threaded execution, such as static web serving, software compilation, and database operations, which all achieved average benchmark ratings. It can handle light LLM inference tasks for smaller models but struggles with larger models. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource ratio, it provides a stable, mid-tier option for standard enterprise applications without the premium cost of specialized compute or memory-optimized hardware.
